## rebar-debug final report — RESOLVED, merged as 1db88c92d7

**Gerrit:** https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/1484 — LLM-Review +1, Verified +1,
submitted, MERGED.

**Proven root cause.** `from tests.unit import _audit_page_helpers as H` at
`tests/unit/test_audit_ticket_page.py:21` and `test_audit_ticket_page_heldout.py:21`. With no
`tests/__init__.py` or `tests/unit/__init__.py`, `tests` resolves only as a PEP-420 namespace
package, which requires the repository root on `sys.path`. pytest's prepend import mode inserts
only `tests/unit`; `tests/conftest.py:39-40` inserts only `tests/`. The repo root is present
solely as a side effect of `python -m pytest` inserting the cwd, so the modules died at
collection under the bare `pytest` console script that `Makefile:215` and
`.github/workflows/_build-and-test.yml:594` actually run.

**Proof.** With `[ui]` installed and cwd `/tmp` (so the repo root cannot reach `sys.path`):
bare `pytest <module>` -> `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'tests'`; `python -m pytest`
from the repo root -> passes. Same interpreter, same extras, same conftest chain — the single
varying input is repo-root-on-`sys.path`, which rules out a missing dependency, a conftest
ordering problem, and an `importorskip` interaction.

**Test.** `tests/unit/test_tests_import_convention.py` — (a) an AST scan asserting no module
under `tests/` uses a `tests.`-rooted import, (b) a subprocess check that both audit-page
modules collect under the bare `pytest` console script from a foreign cwd. All three cases
confirmed RED for the right reason before any fix existed, held out from the fix subagent
(moved out of its tree, path declared off-limits), and GREEN afterwards. Mutation check:
re-seeding the exact `from tests.unit import ...` form returned them to RED; restoring the fix
returned them to GREEN.

**Fix.** Both modules now use the repository's established same-directory convention,
`import _audit_page_helpers as H`, which pytest's prepend mode resolves from `tests/unit`.
`_audit_page_helpers.py` did not move. 15 tests now execute in both invocations (previously 15
under `python -m pytest`, 0 under bare `pytest`).

**Scope & safety.** `_audit_page_helpers` is imported by exactly these two modules (repo-wide
grep) — no behavioural dependants. The change restores coverage that was meant to exist rather
than creating behaviour, adds no dependency, and weakens no test (the diff is +2/-1 import lines
plus a new test file). Full unit suite: 8780 passed.

**Siblings.**
- *Construct axis:* repo-wide AST sweep of `tests/` found these two lines and nothing else;
  the guard test now makes the class unable to return silently.
- *Parity axis:* N/A — a test-module import form has no parallel CLI / API / library surface.
- *Adjacent class (same masking mechanism, different symptom):* filed
  [rebar:f1da-3f9d-8f64-4f4f] for `test_path_injection_guards.py::test_rerun_502_body_has_no_exception_detail`,
  another `importorskip("fastapi")`-masked test that fails the moment the extra IS installed
  (`AttributeError: 'types.SimpleNamespace' object has no attribute 'headers'` from
  `src/rebar/review_bot/app.py:101`). It turned out to be already fixed on main by e548
  (aaf71639b8), which landed after this worktree's base — that ticket is being closed as a
  duplicate.

**Residual risk.** One further observation, dispositioned as *accepted*: a single
`tests/unit/test_epic_bug_screen_4b54.py` "Test leaked new entries into REPO_ROOT" error in the
randomly-ordered full-suite run, which did not reproduce in isolation or alongside the new
guard, and which the CI run on this patch set did not exhibit — no evidence links it to this
change, and there is not enough signal to file a useful ticket.

**Replication.** The original report no longer reproduces: from `/tmp`, bare
`pytest tests/unit/test_audit_ticket_page.py tests/unit/test_audit_ticket_page_heldout.py`
-> 15 passed. CI (which runs bare `pytest`) is Verified +1 on the merged patch set.
